title.native: 這いよれ！ニャル子さん

description:
"I'm Nyarlathotep, the creeping chaos always smiling beside you." But you can call her Nyaruko for short. One by one, the Great Ones from the Cthulhu mythos are coming to earth to target Nyaruko and her human friend Mahiro. He's utterly clueless about the true nature of his cosmic conflict and just wants to live in peace.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description: A Nyarlotephian, who has come to Earth on a mission to protect Mahiro. Nyaruko has a bright personality, as she is always shown to be happy and rarely down. She likes anime, manga, games, and superhero shows. She has perverted thoughts that usually revolve around Mahiro, whom she says to love.

A Cthuko (another alien species), who is Nyaruko's childhood friend from kindergarten and elementary school. Instead of thinking of Nyaruko as her enemy (because they're different species, and both Cthuko and Nyarlotephian are enemies), she loves her deeply. Kuko is usually quiet and blushes a lot. She has really perverted thoughts. Nyaruko calls her 'NEET', due to the fact that she loves games.

A Hastur (alien species), who attended the same space kindergarden and space elementary school with Nyaruko and Chtuko. Despite Hastur's appearence, Hastur is actually a boy. Nyaruko and Cthuko call him "Hasuta-kun". He possess the power of air, and is known to be stronger than both Nyaruko and Cthuko, since he was the one who always stopped their fight during space elementary school.  Hastur is based on Hastur: The deity of the wind.  Hasuta (Shouen version in season 2) is voiced by Seki Tomokazu.
   ~!Hasuta can transform into an older and stronger version of himself, and it is proven in the 3rd episode of the 2nd season that he is quite scary while in his transformation.!~

The male protagonist of the story. Usually avoids close contact with Nyaruko and often stabs her with a fork. Since this is a parody anime, Mahiro is a tsundere. It is shown that Mahiro has feelings for Nyaruko, but doesn't like her aggressiveness.

name.native: ルーヒー・ジストーン

node.description: She is a Cthulhi (also known as the star-spawn of Cthulhu) who was working in company Cthulhu, a space company that producing video games and other entertainment that rivals that of CCE until issues occured.  She now runs a Takoyaki business.
Mahiro's mother who happens to work as a part-time deity hunter. She is a skilled fighter as well as an avid  gamer, she is adept in using ordinary common dining forks as her throwing weapon.

Another classmate of Mahiro's.  She is a member of the school's newspaper club and also very noisy. She is also called "Walking Speaker", and has a habit of gossiping and asking questions like a newsreporter. Tamao is also a close friend of Nyaruko's, telling her usually advices how to get Mahiro hers.    ~!She had a crush on Mahiro, but gave up after Nyaruko's appearance, thinking she has no way to win against her.!~

Nyaruko's pet. A female shantak (monster in Cthulhu mythos, a bird with horse's head and bat's wing). have many different forms including enlarging to stories high, a dog's size. or turn into different vehicles. According to Nyaruko, shantaks' eggs are precious and expensive food in space, despite Mahiro never accepts to eat them. Nyaruko arrived on earth by taking spaceship transformed from Shantak-kun.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Ghutatan comes to earth from the planet Ghatanothoa for Mahiro to take care of her as if he were babysitting her. She is kind of childish for an alien, as seen in episode 11 when the Nyarlathotepian trio chases Mahiro for her. She has a butler named Roy Fooger the Lloigor.   ~!It was revealed that in episode 12 that Lloigor has been using Mahiro so he can bring all of Earth's adult games into space, as Ghutatan has completed her purpose on Earth. After Lloigor is destroyed, Mahiro and the Nyarlathotepian trio wish Ghutatan goodbye as she departs for Ghatanothoa.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)
A classmate of Mahiro's and best friend.   ~!In Season 2 (episode 4), it is revealed, that Yoichi is a pro in any kinds of games that include balls.!~
A member of the Yith race who temporarily borrows Kurei Tamao's body. She later borrows the body of a stuffed animal.

Nyaruko's older brother. He has great hatred and jealousy toward Nyaruko since she graduated from one of the best colleges in space as the best of her year, while he dropped out of a third-class college. To seek revenge, he arrived on Earth and killed the gods in Dreamlands.   ~!He is defeated by Nyaruko with Shantak-kun in her motorcycle form; in the novel he was run over multiple times in Dreamlands and later taken into custody by the Space Defence Agency; in the anime he is bumped on the leg and sent flying. Nyaruko looks down on him as she calls him a "wild Nyarlathotep" rather than her brother in the story.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)
